weeks.title: Zhuyin Initials and the 言 Radical
weeks.theme: Learn the 21 zhuyin initials and start reading Traditional characters through the most common radical change, 讠→言.
goals: Read and say all 21 initials ㄅㄆㄇㄈ ㄉㄊㄋㄌ ㄍㄎㄏ ㄐㄑㄒ ㄓㄔㄕㄖ ㄗㄘㄙ with correct pronunciation
Find every initial on the 大千 keyboard and type them blind
Recognise 30 common 言-radical characters (說話請謝認識課) in Traditional
Order a drink and a breakfast item using set phrases
weeks.zhuyin_focus: Initials ㄅ through ㄙ: their sounds, their order (ㄅㄆㄇㄈ chant) and their keys on the 大千 layout (number row and left-hand rows). Install a 注音 input method and type single initials without looking.
weeks.traditional_focus: 讠→言: 說, 話, 請, 謝, 認識, 課, 讀, 語, 記, 試. Read every word in this week's materials in Traditional only.
weeks.writing_task: Type your name in zhuyin, then type 5 greetings and a 2-line drink order (e.g. 珍奶半糖少冰).
weeks.speaking_focus: Retroflex initials ㄓㄔㄕㄖ versus flat ㄗㄘㄙ: Taiwanese often soften zh→z in casual speech, but learn and produce the standard contrast.

weeks.title: Medials, Finals and 金/食
weeks.theme: Complete the zhuyin system with medials ㄧㄨㄩ and finals ㄚ through ㄦ, and add the 金 and 食 radical families.
goals: Read all 16 finals ㄚㄛㄜㄝㄞㄟㄠㄡㄢㄣㄤㄥㄦ and the medials ㄧㄨㄩ
Spell 40 syllables with medial + final combinations (ㄧㄠ, ㄨㄛ, ㄩㄝ, ㄧㄢ …)
Read 40 Traditional words containing 金 and 食 radicals
Buy something at a convenience store and order night-market food
weeks.zhuyin_focus: Medials ㄧㄨㄩ and finals ㄚ through ㄦ; three-symbol syllables (ㄐㄧㄠ, ㄒㄩㄝ). Locate the medial and final keys on the 大千 layout and type 40 syllables without tones.
weeks.traditional_focus: 钅→金 (錢, 鐵, 銀行, 錯, 鍋) and 饣→食 (飯, 餓, 餃子, 館, 飲料, 餅).
weeks.writing_task: Type 20 food words in zhuyin, then a 3-sentence self-introduction.
weeks.speaking_focus: Finals: ㄥ versus ㄣ (many Taiwanese merge them, but keep them distinct), ㄛ after ㄅㄆㄇㄈ, and ㄦ without 兒化 (Taiwan rarely uses the -r suffix).

weeks.title: Tones, Tone Marks and Spelling Rules
weeks.theme: Master tone marks and zhuyin spelling rules so you can read zhuyin-annotated text, and add the 糸 and 門 families.
goals: Write and type tones correctly: first tone unmarked, ˊ ˇ ˋ, and the neutral-tone dot ˙ written before the syllable
Apply spelling rules: no vowel after ㄓㄔㄕㄖㄗㄘㄙ (知 = ㄓ), ㄩ after ㄐㄑㄒ, ㄧㄡ/ㄨㄟ/ㄨㄣ full spellings
Read a zhuyin-annotated (注音版) children's text aloud
Ride the MRT and buy 鹽酥雞 using only spoken Mandarin
weeks.zhuyin_focus: Tones and tone marks on the 大千 keyboard (space = 1st tone, 6 ˊ, 3 ˇ, 4 ˋ, 7 ˙), syllables with empty rimes, and the spelling rules. Practise typing full syllables with tones and choosing the right character from the candidate list.
weeks.traditional_focus: 纟→糸 (紅, 給, 經驗, 線, 紙, 結婚) and 门→門 (問, 間, 聞, 們, 閉); watch the trap 闹→鬧.
weeks.writing_task: Type your order for 5 drinks and 2 snacks with all tones correct, then a short message asking a friend where to meet at an MRT exit.
weeks.speaking_focus: Tone basics as spoken in Taiwan: the 3rd tone is usually a low 'half-third' without a rise, and Taiwan uses far fewer neutral tones than Beijing speech.

weeks.title: Daqian Keyboard and Speed Typing
weeks.theme: Consolidate zhuyin typing on the 大千 layout and finish the core radical families 貝 and 見; first checkpoint.
goals: Type any syllable on the 大千 layout without looking at the keyboard
Use the IME efficiently: type whole words, let the IME choose, fix wrong candidates
Read 80 Traditional words from the 言/金/食/糸/門/貝/見 families
Get a SIM card and take a taxi
weeks.zhuyin_focus: Full 大千 layout drills, typing whole words and short phrases, using punctuation 「」，。？！ and the 選字 candidate window. Speed typing sprints: reach 10 字/分 by the end of the week.
weeks.traditional_focus: 贝→貝 (貴, 貨, 費, 購, 負) and 见→見 (現, 視, 規, 覺, 親); mixed review of all seven radicals so far.
weeks.writing_task: Write a LINE message (about 50 characters) to a friend planning dinner tonight: time, place, what to eat.
weeks.speaking_focus: Tone sandhi: 3rd + 3rd (你好), 一 (一個 yí, 一天 yì) and 不 (不是 bú); reading zhuyin aloud with sandhi applied.
weeks.milestone: Checkpoint 1: read a 60-character zhuyin-annotated passage aloud with correct tones; type a 50-character message in zhuyin at 10+ 字/分; convert 40 simplified words from the 言/金/食/糸/門/貝/見 families to Traditional with 90% accuracy.

weeks.title: Breakfast Shops and Mornings
weeks.theme: Taiwan's morning routine: the 早餐店, the convenience store and the commute; start reading the novel's opening pages.
goals: Order a full Taiwan breakfast (蛋餅, 蘿蔔糕, 大冰奶) with preferences
Handle the convenience-store questions (袋子, 載具, 微波)
Use 有 + verb and 會 the way Taiwanese do
Read the first pages of the novel with a glossary
weeks.zhuyin_focus: Typing dictation: listen to this week's breakfast dialogues and type them in zhuyin. Target: 12 字/分 typed in zhuyin (大千 layout) at 95%+ accuracy.
weeks.traditional_focus: 车→車 and 马→馬 families (軍, 較, 輸, 連; 嗎, 媽, 騎, 驗).
weeks.writing_task: Type a LINE message ordering breakfast for three coworkers, with each person's 甜度/冰塊 or sauce preferences.
weeks.speaking_focus: Polite ordering register (阿姨, 老闆, 麻煩, 謝謝) and Taiwan's 這個 pronounced zhèi ge.

weeks.title: Night Markets and Street Food
weeks.theme: Explore night-market culture: food names, Taiwanese loanwords and the particles that make speech sound local.
goals: Name 20 night-market foods, including Taiwanese-derived names (蚵仔煎, 甜不辣)
Order food, ask prices and get recommendations
Use 喔 and 啦 naturally in short reactions
Write a short food review
weeks.zhuyin_focus: Typing food names quickly, including Taiwanese-derived words that the IME may not suggest first (蚵仔煎, 雞排, 臭豆腐). Target: 14 字/分 typed in zhuyin (大千 layout) at 95%+ accuracy.
weeks.traditional_focus: 鸟→鳥, 鱼→魚, 页→頁 (雞, 鴨, 島; 鮮, 魯, 漁; 題, 順, 顏).
weeks.writing_task: Type a 100-character review of a night-market snack, as if posting on Google Maps.
weeks.speaking_focus: Taiwanese loanwords in Mandarin (蚵仔煎, 歹勢, 古錐) and the particles 喔/啦: friendly versus impatient intonation.

weeks.title: Getting Around Town
weeks.title_zh: 搭捷運、坐計程車、騎機車
weeks.theme: Navigate Taiwanese cities by MRT, taxi and scooter, including the rules newcomers get wrong.
goals: Give and follow directions with 往, 轉乘, 出口, 路口
Top up an EasyCard and take a taxi to a specific spot
Explain scooter rules such as 兩段式左轉
Read MRT notices and route maps in Traditional
weeks.zhuyin_focus: Typing directions and place names: station names, road names (路/街/巷/弄) and numbers. Target: 15 字/分 typed in zhuyin (大千 layout) at 95%+ accuracy.
weeks.traditional_focus: Component families 長, 東, 韋, 風, 侖, 區 (張, 陳, 偉, 瘋, 論, 歐).
weeks.writing_task: Type step-by-step directions for a friend arriving at 台北車站 who needs to reach your apartment.
weeks.speaking_focus: Taiwan-specific readings, part 1: 星期 qí, 期 qí, 垃圾 lè sè, 微 wéi; know both forms, prefer the Taiwan one.

weeks.title: Long-Distance Travel by Rail
weeks.theme: Plan intercity trips by 高鐵 and 台鐵, including a first trip to 彰化, the novel's setting.
goals: Buy HSR and TRA tickets with time, seat and discount requests
Read timetables and ticket information
Talk about times, dates and durations fluently
Describe 彰化 and the novel's setting in a few sentences
weeks.zhuyin_focus: Typing numbers, times and dates mixed with characters (下午1點, 12月3日), and typing train names and station names. Target: 16 字/分 typed in zhuyin (大千 layout) at 95%+ accuracy.
weeks.traditional_focus: Families 龍, 堯, 戔, 專, 會, 單 (寵, 燒, 錢, 傳, 會, 單).
weeks.writing_task: Type a weekend itinerary for a trip to 彰化 (trains, times, places to visit), about 150 characters.
weeks.speaking_focus: Numbers, prices and times said fast; 101 read as yī líng yī; dates and the 民國 year system.

weeks.title: Home and Neighbourhood
weeks.theme: Rent a room, deal with a landlord and fit into neighbourhood life, from the garbage truck to the 里長.
goals: Ask about rent, deposit, utilities and house rules
Explain a repair problem to a landlord
Sort rubbish correctly and talk to neighbours
Read a rental listing on 591
weeks.zhuyin_focus: Typing a message to a landlord: polite openings, describing problems, asking for times. Target: 18 字/分 typed in zhuyin (大千 layout) at 95%+ accuracy.
weeks.traditional_focus: Families 闌, 兩, 盧, 羅, 買/賣, 䜌 (欄, 輛, 爐, 蘿, 讀, 戀, 變, 灣).
weeks.writing_task: Type a LINE message to your 房東 reporting a broken water heater and proposing repair times.
weeks.speaking_focus: Taiwan's reduced neutral tone: 東西, 衣服, 時候, 先生, 地方 often keep full tones; practise both and notice the Taiwan pattern.

weeks.title: Health and Clinics
weeks.theme: Use Taiwan's health system: 健保卡, 掛號, clinics and pharmacies.
goals: Register at a clinic and describe symptoms precisely
Understand dosage instructions on a 藥袋
Ask for sick leave and a doctor's note
Buy over-the-counter medicine and mention allergies
weeks.zhuyin_focus: Typing symptoms and body vocabulary; dictation of a doctor's instructions. Target: 19 字/分 typed in zhuyin (大千 layout) at 95%+ accuracy.
weeks.traditional_focus: Families 監, 當, 𤇾 (營/榮/勞), 𦥯 (學/覺), 臤 (堅/緊), 戠 (識/職).
weeks.writing_task: Type a sick-leave message to your manager explaining symptoms and the doctor's advice.
weeks.speaking_focus: Taiwan-specific readings, part 2: 液 yì, 質 zhí, 咳嗽 ké sou, 頭髮 tóu fǎ.

weeks.title: Shopping and Errands
weeks.theme: Get things done: supermarkets, Costco, the post office and returning faulty goods.
goals: Compare prices, promotions and member cards
Send a parcel and choose a shipping method
Return or exchange an item politely but firmly
Read receipts (發票) and product labels
weeks.zhuyin_focus: Typing complaint and request emails with formal set phrases (您好, 麻煩您, 謝謝您的協助). Target: 20 字/分 typed in zhuyin (大千 layout) at 95%+ accuracy.
weeks.traditional_focus: Families 昜, 咼, 僉, 將, 齊, 麗, 岡, 夾, 倉, 亞; 发 as a component (撥, 廢) and the 广/廣 trap.
weeks.reading_genre: receipts, product labels and store policy
weeks.writing_task: Type a 150-character return request to an online shop citing the 七天鑑賞期.
weeks.speaking_focus: Polite complaints: softening with 不好意思, 可能, 是不是, and the rising intonation of 可以……嗎？

weeks.title: Money, Banking and Checkpoint 2
weeks.title_zh: 開戶理財與第二次檢測
weeks.theme: Open a bank account, handle payments and review the first quarter.
goals: Open a bank account and set up online banking
Talk about payments: 轉帳, LINE Pay, 刷卡, 現金
Read Traditional text from all 48 component families without help
Hold a 2-minute monologue about your week in Taiwan
weeks.zhuyin_focus: Typing review: timed transcription of a familiar dialogue, then free typing of a diary entry. Target: 22 字/分 typed in zhuyin (大千 layout) at 95%+ accuracy.
weeks.traditional_focus: Review all component families; start whole-character changes with the highest-frequency words: 這, 個, 們, 來, 時, 會, 為, 樣, 還, 過, 從, 開.
weeks.writing_task: Type a 200-character diary entry: 我在台灣的一個禮拜.
weeks.speaking_focus: Fluency check: a 2-minute monologue recorded and compared with a native model for tones and rhythm.
weeks.milestone: Checkpoint 2: (1) 15-minute conversation covering 5 daily-life scenarios; (2) type a 200-character diary at 22+ 字/分; (3) convert a 150-character simplified passage to Traditional with 90%+ accuracy; (4) summarise what has happened so far in the novel (about 10%) in 5 sentences.

weeks.title: Eating Out with Friends
weeks.theme: Group dinners, 熱炒, KTV and the etiquette of treating, toasting and splitting the bill.
goals: Order shared dishes and drinks for a group
Toast with 乾杯 and decline with 隨意
Split the bill or treat someone naturally
Use banter particles 啦, 欸, 耶 correctly
weeks.zhuyin_focus: Typing in a group chat in real time: organising a dinner, replying quickly, using stickers sparingly. Target: 23 字/分 typed in zhuyin (大千 layout) at 95%+ accuracy.
weeks.traditional_focus: Whole-character changes for food and eating out: 點, 熱, 鹽, 蝦, 盤, 條, 鳳, 豬, 麥, 樣.
weeks.writing_task: Type a group-chat message organising a 熱炒 dinner and, afterwards, a message asking everyone to transfer their share.
weeks.speaking_focus: Banter particles 啦, 欸, 耶, 喔 and their intonation; teasing and replying to teasing.

weeks.title: Self-Care and Services
weeks.theme: Hair salons, gyms and personal services: describe what you want and decline upselling.
goals: Describe a haircut, colour and style
Explain fitness goals and ask about plans and contracts
Decline a sales pitch politely
Write an online review of a service
weeks.zhuyin_focus: Typing descriptive language (adjectives, comparisons) for reviews. Target: 24 字/分 typed in zhuyin (大千 layout) at 95%+ accuracy.
weeks.traditional_focus: Whole-character changes for the body and self-care: 頭, 體, 醫, 藥, 傷, 療, 壓, 養, 衛, 適.
weeks.writing_task: Type a 200-character Google review of a hair salon or gym.
weeks.speaking_focus: Retroflex softening: recognise z/c/s for zh/ch/sh in fast Taiwanese speech while keeping your own standard.

weeks.title: Weather and Typhoons
weeks.theme: Weather talk, typhoon culture and dealing with things going wrong.
goals: Discuss weather forecasts and typhoon warnings
Follow a 停班停課 announcement
Complain effectively about a delivery problem
Read a short typhoon news brief
weeks.zhuyin_focus: Typing news-style sentences; dictation of a weather forecast. Target: 25 字/分 typed in zhuyin (大千 layout) at 95%+ accuracy.
weeks.traditional_focus: Whole-character changes for home and weather: 電, 燈, 廳, 廚, 牆, 樓, 陽, 陰, 掃, 曬.
weeks.writing_task: Type a Facebook-style post about your typhoon day (about 200 characters).
weeks.speaking_focus: Tag particles 齁 and 吼 and the reactions 對啊, 真的假的, 是喔.

weeks.title: Weekend Outings
weeks.theme: Hiking, hot springs and day trips: narrate experiences in the past.
goals: Plan a weekend outing and invite friends
Describe scenery and feelings during a hike
Explain hot-spring etiquette
Write a travel blog post
weeks.zhuyin_focus: Typing narrative paragraphs with time sequencing (先, 然後, 後來, 最後). Target: 26 字/分 typed in zhuyin (大千 layout) at 95%+ accuracy.
weeks.traditional_focus: Whole-character changes for travel: 飛, 機, 遠, 邊, 園, 鄉, 縣, 橋, 廟, 陸.
weeks.writing_task: Type a 250-character travel blog post about a day trip.
weeks.speaking_focus: Storytelling past events with 有 + verb (我有去), 了 and 過; Taiwan's 夕 read xì.

weeks.title: Taiwanese School Life
weeks.theme: School and exam culture then and now: 聯考, 學測, 補習班; the heart of the novel's world.
goals: Describe the Taiwanese school system and entrance exams
Talk about study stress and cram schools
Understand school vocabulary in the novel (班導, 週記, 考卷, 模擬考)
Write a 週記 like a Taiwanese high-schooler
weeks.zhuyin_focus: Typing a weekly journal; practising 「」 quotation marks for dialogue. Target: 27 字/分 typed in zhuyin (大千 layout) at 95%+ accuracy.
weeks.traditional_focus: Whole-character changes for school: 書, 筆, 畢, 業, 習, 補, 聯, 導, 寫, 數.
weeks.reading_genre: school notice and student 週記
weeks.writing_task: Type a 300-character 週記 (weekly journal) in the voice of a 1990s 彰化 high-school student.
weeks.speaking_focus: Classroom reading voice (國語課朗讀) versus natural speech; school slang.

weeks.title: LINE and Online Chat
weeks.theme: Chat culture: LINE etiquette, stickers, 已讀不回 and the particles that carry tone in text.
goals: Chat naturally in LINE with particles and emoji-like expressions
Interpret tone from particles (喔 vs 喔～ vs 哦)
Make and change plans by phone and chat
Understand common chat abbreviations
weeks.zhuyin_focus: Live chat with the tutor typed in zhuyin; aim to reply within 30 seconds. Target: 28 字/分 typed in zhuyin (大千 layout) at 95%+ accuracy.
weeks.traditional_focus: Whole-character changes for social life and emotion: 愛, 歡, 懷, 夢, 難, 驚, 興, 態, 雙, 隨.
weeks.writing_task: Type replies in a simulated LINE group: invite, reschedule, apologise, using particles naturally.
weeks.speaking_focus: Fast casual phone speech: 喂, 欸, fillers 然後, 就是, 那個; ending calls with 先這樣.

weeks.title: PTT, Dcard and Internet Slang
weeks.theme: Taiwan's internet culture: PTT, Dcard, memes and slang, many from Taiwanese Hokkien.
goals: Explain 15 internet slang terms (母湯, 87, 傻眼貓咪, 吃土, 魯蛇)
Read a PTT post and its 推文
Recognise which slang is dated and which is current
React to posts like a 鄉民
weeks.zhuyin_focus: Typing slang, numbers-as-words (87) and English mixed in; fast short replies. Target: 29 字/分 typed in zhuyin (大千 layout) at 95%+ accuracy.
weeks.traditional_focus: Whole-character changes for media and internet: 網, 號, 顯, 響, 戲, 劇, 圖, 錄, 聲, 聽.
weeks.writing_task: Type a PTT-style post (標題 + 內文) and write five 推文 replies to it.
weeks.speaking_focus: Pronouncing slang: 87 (bā qī), 母湯, 是在哈囉, letters inside Chinese (K書, OK, CP值).

weeks.title: Dating and Relationships
weeks.theme: Crushes, confessions and relationships: the emotional language the novel lives on.
goals: Describe crushes, 曖昧 and 告白
Ask someone out and respond to an invitation
Talk through a relationship problem
Understand romantic scenes in the novel
weeks.zhuyin_focus: Typing emotional language; one-to-many traps first appear in typing drills. Target: 30 字/分 typed in zhuyin (大千 layout) at 95%+ accuracy.
weeks.traditional_focus: One-to-many traps: 發/髮 and 乾/幹/干 (note 幹 as the novel's favourite swear word).
weeks.writing_task: Type a 告白 message (about 200 characters) and a reply turning it down kindly.
weeks.speaking_focus: Softening and 撒嬌 register with 啦, 嘛, 喔; emotional prosody.

weeks.title: Family and Lunar New Year
weeks.theme: Family life and New Year customs: 圍爐, 紅包, nosy relatives and speaking with elders.
goals: Give New Year greetings and blessings
Talk to elders respectfully and deflect nosy questions
Explain New Year foods and customs
Understand Taiwanese-accented Mandarin (台灣國語)
weeks.zhuyin_focus: Typing blessings and four-character expressions (恭喜發財, 身體健康, 年年有餘). Target: 31 字/分 typed in zhuyin (大千 layout) at 95%+ accuracy.
weeks.traditional_focus: One-to-many traps: 麵/面, 後/后, 鹹/咸, 薑/姜.
weeks.writing_task: Type New Year messages to three people (a boss, a grandparent, a friend) in suitable registers.
weeks.speaking_focus: Understanding older speakers: ㄈ/ㄏ merging, flattened retroflexes and Hokkien words such as 呷飽未, 乖孫, 歹勢.

weeks.title: Temples and Folk Religion
weeks.theme: Taiwanese folk religion: temples, 拜拜, 擲筊, 抽籤, 月老 and 媽祖.
goals: Describe how to worship at a temple step by step
Explain 擲筊 results and fortune poems
Discuss the role of temples in community life
Read temple signage in Traditional
weeks.zhuyin_focus: Typing explanations of a process with ordinal markers (首先, 接著, 然後, 最後). Target: 32 字/分 typed in zhuyin (大千 layout) at 95%+ accuracy.
weeks.traditional_focus: One-to-many traps: 裡/里, 隻/只, 籤/簽.
weeks.reading_genre: temple signage and 籤詩 explanation
weeks.writing_task: Type a 300-character explanation of a temple visit for a foreign friend.
weeks.speaking_focus: Ritual and respectful register; Hokkien terms used in Mandarin (拜拜, 擲筊, 媽祖遶境).

weeks.title: Sports and Youth
weeks.theme: Basketball, school sports and male friendship, central to the novel's group of friends.
goals: Talk during a pickup basketball game
Describe a game and a player's performance
Banter and trash-talk playfully
Discuss friendship among the novel's characters
weeks.zhuyin_focus: Typing live commentary in short bursts. Target: 33 字/分 typed in zhuyin (大千 layout) at 95%+ accuracy.
weeks.traditional_focus: One-to-many traps: 鬥/斗, 衝/沖, 準/准.
weeks.writing_task: Type a 250-character sports news brief about a school basketball game.
weeks.speaking_focus: Quick reactions and shouting: 好球, 加油, 傳球, 欸欸欸; rhythm in rapid exchanges.

weeks.title: Pop Music and Checkpoint 3
weeks.title_zh: 流行音樂與第三次檢測
weeks.theme: Mandopop, KTV culture and the film of 那些年; mid-year checkpoint.
goals: Discuss Taiwanese pop music and KTV culture
Explain lyrics of one Taiwanese song
Talk about the novel's first third and its characters
Hold a 3-minute spontaneous conversation
weeks.zhuyin_focus: Typing song lyrics from listening (dictation). Target: 35 字/分 typed in zhuyin (大千 layout) at 95%+ accuracy.
weeks.traditional_focus: One-to-many traps: 颱/檯/台 and 復/複/覆; review all traps so far.
weeks.reading_genre: song lyrics (五月天) and a fan article
weeks.writing_task: Type a 400-character essay: 我這半年的中文.
weeks.speaking_focus: 3-minute spontaneous talk recorded and compared with a native model.
weeks.milestone: Checkpoint 3: (1) 20-minute conversation on media, slang and relationships; (2) type a 400-character essay at 35+ 字/分; (3) 50-item one-to-many quiz (90%); (4) explain the novel's first 35% (characters, setting, key events) for 3 minutes.

weeks.title: Office Life
weeks.theme: Taiwanese office culture: hierarchy, lunch, overtime, leave and the 尾牙.
goals: Make office small talk and join group orders
Use workplace titles (經理, 協理, 副理) and polite forms
Request leave and discuss workload
Toast at a 尾牙
weeks.zhuyin_focus: Typing formal emails: subject line, greeting, request, closing (敬祝 商祺). Target: 36 字/分 typed in zhuyin (大千 layout) at 95%+ accuracy.
weeks.traditional_focus: One-to-many traps: 係/繫/系, 製/制, 徵/征.
weeks.writing_task: Type a formal email to your manager requesting annual leave and handing over tasks.
weeks.speaking_focus: Workplace register: 您, 麻煩, 辛苦了, 不好意思打擾一下.

weeks.title: Taiwanese Food Culture
weeks.theme: Food as culture: 古早味, north-south rivalry, bubble tea history and food memories.
goals: Describe flavours and textures (QQ, Q彈, 古早味)
Compare northern and southern Taiwanese food
Explain the history of a Taiwanese dish
Give an opinion in podcast style
weeks.zhuyin_focus: Typing a longer descriptive essay with sensory vocabulary. Target: 37 字/分 typed in zhuyin (大千 layout) at 95%+ accuracy.
